claims.text: The hotel is in Gangnam, near the COEX Convention center.

findings.quote: Perfectly located in the Gangnam near the COEX Convention

claims.text: The hotel is a one-minute walk from Exit 1 of Samseong Station.

findings.quote: Park Hyatt Seoul is a 1-minute walk from Exit 1 of Samseong Station.

claims.text: Bongeun temple, art galleries, shopping, outdoor parks and paths along the Han River are within easy reach.

findings.quote: You’re within easy reach of cultural sites such as Bongeun temple, along with art galleries, shopping, outdoor parks and paths along the Han River.

claims.text: The lobby is on the 24th floor, with high ceilings and contemporary Korean art.

findings.quote: It's only after ascending to the lobby on the 24th floor that the hotel experience opens up: The ceilings are high, the room is full of air and light (as well as some eye-catching contemporary Korean art)

claims.text: Bedrooms are finished in pale oak, and bathrooms in rough Japanese stone and heavy marble.

findings.quote: The dominant materials are acres of pale oak in the bedrooms and rough Japanese stone and heavy marble in the bathrooms.

claims.text: Bathrooms have spa-inspired rain showers and spacious bathtubs.

findings.quote: Sleek designed bathrooms appointed with spa-inspired rain showers and spacious bathtubs

claims.text: The Presidential Suite is on the top floor, with panoramic city views and Korean accents.

findings.quote: A 160-square-meter suite on the top floor, offering panoramic city views and curated luxury with Korean accents.

claims.text: Cornerstone, the main restaurant on the 2nd floor, serves Italian dishes.

findings.quote: Located on the 2nd floor, our main restaurant, Cornerstone, offers authentic Italian dishes

claims.text: Cornerstone offers a gift selection from Pierre Herme Paris, including macarons and chocolates.

findings.quote: Guests may also discover a gift selection from Pierre Hermé Paris, including macarons and chocolates, at Cornerstone.

claims.text: The Timber House has live performances every evening.

findings.quote: Guests can also enjoy live performances every evening,

claims.text: Room service is available 24 hours a day.

findings.quote: Room Service is available 24 hours a day

claims.text: The hotel offers stroller and baby bed rentals as well as babysitting services.

findings.quote: we also provide Hartan stroller and Daiichi baby bed rentals, as well as babysitting services.

claims.text: The Timber House is a whisky and cocktail bar, reached through a hidden passageway, that reinterprets Korean tradition through a contemporary lens.

findings.quote: Reached through a hidden passageway, The Timber House is a premium whisky and cocktail bar that reinterprets the beauty of Korean tradition through a contemporary lens.

claims.text: The granite-lined indoor swimming pool is designed in an infinity pool style, with sunlight through floor-to-ceiling windows.

findings.quote: The granite-lined indoor swimming pool at Park Hyatt Seoul is designed in an infinity pool style, offering a unique atmosphere each hour as natural sunlight streams through the floor-to-ceiling windows.

claims.text: The Lounge serves contemporary Korean cuisine with seasonal ingredients and French cooking techniques, alongside traditional teas and a signature afternoon tea.

findings.quote: Alongside a premium collection of traditional teas and signature afternoon tea, The Lounge presents contemporary dining that brings together Korean cuisine made with seasonal ingredients, French cooking techniques, and delicate plating.

claims.text: It was the first hotel from the Japanese architecture firm Super Potato.

findings.quote: This was the first hotel from the Japanese architecture firm Super Potato

claims.text: Ocelas Spa at Park Club has three private treatment rooms and a citrus bar serving Korean-inspired refreshments.

findings.quote: Three private treatment rooms offer undisturbed rest and relaxation, while a citrus bar serves a selection of Korean-inspired refreshments.

claims.text: One set of elevators runs between street level and the top-level lounge and another goes to the rooms, which can be slightly confusing.

findings.quote: it is slightly confusing to have one set that goes between street level and the top-level lounge and another that goes to the rooms.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
WhataHotel notes the formal atmosphere may not suit all leisure travelers.
